Subject: Missed technical walkthrough — timezone mix-up, propose three rescue slots + ops checklist

Hi Jordan —

We were expecting your team for the 1:00pm PT walkthrough today but the room was empty. No worries — these things happen (timezones are sneaky). Would you be able to rebook?

Quick asks so we make the next session high-value:
- Do you want an SE-led technical deep dive (recommended) or a shorter PM product overview?
- Any specific integration or compliance items we should prep for (SSO, VPC, data residency)?

Proposed rescue windows (all in PT unless you tell me otherwise):
1) Mon 3/20 10:00–11:00am PT (SE + PM)
2) Tue 3/21 8:00–8:45am PT (shorter, SE-led)
3) Wed 3/22 20:00–21:00 PT (APAC-friendly, SE only)

I’ve attached a short ops checklist and sandbox access doc — if you can confirm which slot works I’ll loop in Ben (SE) and Monica (PM) and send an invite.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Onboarding: +1-415-555-0198

Best slots for us: 3/21 morning your time (your option 2 works) or 3/22 evening if you can do the APAC slot. Either Samir or I will be on the call.

Thanks for the docs — I’ll skim and circle back if we need anything pre-provisioned.

jordan@finalpha.com
